questions.question: If 7 N force is applied on a brick and it moves through 5 m, then what will be the work done?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**35 J**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Work is calculated using the formula: **Work = Force × Displacement × cos(θ)**, where θ is the angle between the force and displacement.
 
• Here, the force applied is **7 N**, and the displacement is **5 m**.
 
• If the force and displacement are in the same direction, cos(θ) = cos(0°) = 1.
 
• Thus, Work = 7 × 5 × 1 = **35 J**.
 
• The unit of work in the SI system is the **joule (J)**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Work:**

 
 
• Work is done when a force is applied to an object, and the object moves in the direction of the force.
 
• It is a scalar quantity, meaning it has magnitude but no direction.
 
• The formula for work (W) is **W = F × d × cos(θ)**, where:
 
 
• F = Force applied (N)
 
• d = Displacement (m)
 
• θ = Angle between the force and displacement
 
 
 
 
 
• **Joule:**
 
 
• The joule (J) is the SI unit of work and energy.
 
• **1 joule is equivalent to 1 newton-meter (N·m)**.
 
• It represents the work done when a force of 1 newton displaces an object by 1 meter in the direction of the force.
 
 
 
• **Factors Affecting Work:**
 
 
• The magnitude of the force applied.
 
• The displacement caused by the force.
 
• The angle between the force and the displacement.
 
 
 
• **Work in Different Systems:**
 
 
• In the CGS system, the unit of work is the erg.
 
• **1 erg = 10⁻⁷ joules.**

questions.question: Which of the following is a duty of the Attorney General of India?

options.text: To give advice to the Government of India on legal matters
To act as a judge in the Supreme Court
To represent India in international bodies

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **To give advice to the Government of India on legal matters**.

__
 
• **The Attorney General of India** is the chief legal advisor to the Government of India.
 
• He/she is appointed by the **President of India** under Article 76 of the Constitution.
 
• The primary duty is to **give legal advice** to the Government of India on various matters.
 
• The Attorney General also represents the government in the **Supreme Court** and other courts.
 
• He/she does not act as a judge or advise state governments.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Title
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Attorney General of India
 The highest law officer in the country, responsible for advising the Government of India on legal matters.
 
 

 Solicitor General of India
 An officer who assists the Attorney General and represents the government in court when required.
 
 

 Advocate General
 The highest law officer in a state, responsible for advising the state government on legal matters.
 
 

 Public Prosecutor
 A lawyer appointed to prosecute cases on behalf of the government.
 
 

 Legal Advisor
 A professional who provides legal guidance and advice to organizations or individuals.

questions.question: What is a budget deficit?

options.text: The excess of government revenue over expenditure
The amount of money allocated for defence spending
The amount of money allocated for social welfare programmes
The excess of government expenditure over revenue

questions.solution:
The correct answer is **the excess of government expenditure over revenue**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Budget deficit** occurs when a government spends more money than it receives in revenue.
 
• This usually results in the government having to borrow money to cover the shortfall.
 
• A persistent budget deficit can lead to an increase in public debt.
 
• Managing a budget deficit often involves either increasing revenue (e.g., through taxes) or cutting expenditures.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Budget deficit** is a key indicator of a government's fiscal health.

 
 

 Term
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Fiscal Deficit
 The total amount by which a government's expenditures exceed its revenue, excluding money from borrowings.
 
 

 Public Debt
 The total amount of money that a government owes to creditors, both domestic and international.
 
 

 Revenue Deficit
 The excess of current expenditure over current revenue, indicating the shortfall in the government's revenue.
 
 

 Primary Deficit
 The fiscal deficit of a government excluding interest payments on previous borrowings.

• It does not result in the creation of **tangible assets** or **reduction in liabilities**.

 Spending on the regular functioning of the government and maintenance of assets, such as salaries and pensions.

 Spending on the acquisition of assets like buildings, machinery, equipment, or land.
 
 

 Development Expenditure
 Spending on projects and programs aimed at economic development, such as infrastructure projects.
 
 

 Non-Development Expenditure
 Spending on items that do not directly contribute to economic development, such as defense or administrative expenses.

questions.question: The holy mountain ‘Kailash’ is located in which neighbouring country of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **China**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mount Kailash** is located in the Tibet Autonomous Region of **China**.
 
• It is considered a sacred mountain in four religions: **Hinduism, Buddhism, Jainism, and Bon**.
 
• Mount Kailash is part of the **Kailash Range**, which forms part of the Transhimalaya in Tibet.
 
• The mountain is approximately **6,638 meters (21,778 feet)** high.
 
• It is near the source of some of the longest rivers in Asia: the **Indus, Sutlej, Brahmaputra, and Karnali** (a tributary of the Ganges).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Aspect
 Description
 
 
 
 

 Religious Significance
 **Mount Kailash** is considered the abode of **Lord Shiva** in Hinduism, and it is also revered in Buddhism as the home of the Buddha Demchok.
 
 

 Pilgrimage
 Every year, thousands of pilgrims undertake the **Kailash Mansarovar Yatra** to circumambulate the sacred mountain and take a dip in the nearby **Lake Mansarovar**.
 
 

 Geographical Location
 Mount Kailash is located near the **sources of four major rivers** in Asia, which are crucial for the water supply of millions of people.
 
 

 Environmental Conservation
 The region around **Mount Kailash** is protected to preserve its unique environmental and cultural heritage.
 
 

 Mythological Importance
 In Jainism, Mount Kailash is known as **Ashtapada** and is believed to be the site where the first Jain Tirthankara, Rishabhadeva, attained Nirvana.

questions.question: In which of the following states of India the ‘Loo’ wind does NOT blow during the summer season?

__
 
• The **Loo** is a strong, hot, and dry summer wind that blows across the **northwestern parts of India**.
 
• It is prevalent in states like **Punjab, Rajasthan, and Haryana** during the summer months.
 
• **Goa** does not experience the Loo wind because it is located in the **coastal region** and has a different climatic pattern.
 
• The coastal regions generally have a **moderate climate** due to the influence of the sea, which regulates the temperature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

The **Loo** wind is a significant weather phenomenon in the northwestern parts of India during the summer season. Here are some important details:

 
 

 Aspect
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **Nature**
 The Loo is a **hot, dry wind** that significantly raises the temperature.
 
 

 **Duration**
 It typically occurs from **May to June**.
 
 

 **Regions Affected**
 Primarily affects **northwestern India**, including **Punjab, Haryana, Rajasthan, and Uttar Pradesh**.
 
 

 **Health Impact**
 Can cause **heat strokes** and **dehydration** due to extremely high temperatures.
 
 

 **Mitigation**
 People are advised to **stay indoors**, **hydrate** frequently, and **avoid direct sunlight** during peak hours.

questions.question:
The Wild Life (Protection) Amendment Act, 2022 seeks to implement the Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species of Wild Fauna and Flora (CITES). Which of the following statements is correct about CITES?

1. CITES is an agreement between governments to ensure that international trade in the specimens of wild animals and plants does not threaten the survival of the species.

2. Under CITES, plant and animal specimens are classified into five categories based on the threat to their extinction.

3. The Convention requires countries to regulate the trade of all listed specimens through permits.

4. It also seeks to regulate the possession of live animal specimens.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **1, 3 and 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Statement 1:** CITES is an agreement between governments to ensure that international trade in the specimens of wild animals and plants does not threaten the survival of the species. **Hence, Statement 1 is correct.**
 
• **Statement 2:** Under CITES, plant and animal specimens are classified into five categories based on the threat to their extinction. This is incorrect as CITES classifies them into three Appendices, not five categories. **Hence, Statement 2 is incorrect.**
 
• **Statement 3:** The Convention requires countries to regulate the trade of all listed specimens through permits. This is correct. **Hence, Statement 3 is correct.**
 
• **Statement 4:** It also seeks to regulate the possession of live animal specimens. This is correct. **Hence, Statement 4 is correct.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ ** ** Applications****:**

 
• **Appendix I:** Includes species threatened with extinction. Trade in these species is permitted only in exceptional circumstances.
 
• **Appendix II:** Includes species not necessarily threatened with extinction, but trade must be controlled to avoid utilization incompatible with their survival.
 
• **Appendix III:** Includes species that are protected in at least one country, which has asked other CITES Parties for assistance in controlling the trade.

questions.question: Which age group of the population are covered under the Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY) scheme of the Government of India?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **15 to 35 years**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Deen Dayal Upadhyaya Grameen Kaushalya Yojana (DDU-GKY)** targets the **rural youth** in the age group of **15 to 35 years**.
 
• Its main aim is to **enhance the employability** of the rural youth by providing them with skill training.
 
• The scheme is part of the **National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM)**, which focuses on promoting self-employment and organization of rural poor.
 
• It is designed to **bridge the skill gap** and make rural youth employable in various sectors.

• It is funded by the **Ministry of Rural Development (MoRD)**, Government of India.
 
• The scheme aims to train **10 million rural youth** by 2022.
 
• **DDU-GKY** works in partnership with **various training partners** to provide training in different sectors such as **retail, hospitality, health, construction,** and **automobile**.
 
• Special focus is given to **vulnerable groups** such as **women, differently-abled persons,** and those belonging to **Scheduled Castes (SCs)** and **Scheduled Tribes (STs)**.

questions.question: Which gland gets enlarged in the goitre due to which there is a swelling in the front part of the throat?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Thyroid gland**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The thyroid gland is located in the front part of the neck, just below the Adam's apple.
 
• Goitre is a condition where the thyroid gland becomes abnormally enlarged.
 
• This enlargement can cause a noticeable swelling in the neck, leading to discomfort and difficulty in swallowing or breathing.
 
• Goitre can be caused by iodine deficiency, autoimmune diseases, or other thyroid disorders.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Option 1
 Adrenal gland: Located on top of each kidney, responsible for producing hormones like adrenaline and cortisol.
 
 

 Option 2
 Thyroid gland: Located in the neck, produces hormones that regulate metabolism, energy generation, and growth.
 
 

 Option 3
 Pineal gland: A small gland in the brain that produces melatonin, which regulates sleep-wake cycles.
 
 

 Option 4
 Pituitary gland: Located at the base of the brain, it is known as the "master gland" because it controls other endocrine glands.

questions.question: Which of the following does NOT come under Fundamental Duties?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **To pay taxes**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Fundamental Duties** are enshrined in Article 51A of the Indian Constitution.
 
• They were added by the 42nd Amendment Act in 1976.
 
• There are currently **11 Fundamental Duties** listed in the Constitution.
 
• Paying taxes is not included in the list of Fundamental Duties.
 
• The duties primarily focus on promoting a sense of patriotism and upholding the unity of India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

**Fundamental Duties** were inspired by the Constitution of the former **Soviet Union**. They serve as a reminder to citizens that while enjoying their rights, they also have certain responsibilities towards the nation.

 
 

 Duty
 Description
 
 
 
 

 To abide by the Constitution and respect its ideals
 Citizens are expected to follow the Constitution and respect its principles.
 
 

 To cherish and follow the noble ideals
 Promote values that inspired the national struggle for freedom.
 
 

 To uphold and protect the sovereignty
 Defend the country's sovereignty, unity, and integrity.
 
 

 To defend the country
 Serve the nation when called upon to do so.
 
 

 To promote harmony
 Foster harmony and the spirit of common brotherhood.
 
 

 To value and preserve the rich heritage
 Protect and preserve the country's composite culture.
 
 

 To protect and improve the natural environment
 Safeguard the environment, including forests, lakes, rivers, and wildlife.
 
 

 To develop scientific temper
 Encourage scientific temper, humanism, and the spirit of inquiry and reform.
 
 

 To safeguard public property
 Protect public property and avoid violence.
 
 

 To strive towards excellence
 Continuously strive for excellence in all spheres of individual and collective activity.
 
 

 To provide opportunities for education
 Ensure that one's child or ward is provided opportunities for education.

questions.question: In which year did the All-India Muslim League move a resolution demanding ‘Independent States’ for Muslims in the north-western and eastern areas of the country?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **1940**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **All-India Muslim League** was a political party in British India that played a crucial role in the creation of Pakistan.
 
• The resolution for 'Independent States' was moved during the **Lahore Session** of the All-India Muslim League.
 
• This resolution is commonly known as the **Lahore Resolution** or the **Pakistan Resolution**.
 
• The resolution demanded separate states for Muslims in the north-western and eastern zones of India.
 
• This resolution laid the foundation for the creation of Pakistan in 1947.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 Term
 Description
 
 
 
 

 **All-India Muslim League**
 A political party established in 1906 to advocate for the interests of Muslims in British India.
 
 

 **Lahore Resolution**
 A formal political statement adopted in 1940, calling for separate states for Muslims in India.
 
 

 **Pakistan Resolution**
 Another name for the Lahore Resolution, which eventually led to the creation of Pakistan.
 
 

 **1947 Partition**
 The division of British India into two independent dominions, India and Pakistan.
 
 

 **British India**
 The territories in the Indian subcontinent that were under the administration of the British from 1858 to 1947.
